assessments.reasoning: The Release 754 DATA topic places valid DATA(var) in a writing declaration position and makes the variable statically visible from there. The Effect expressly places declaration at compilation regardless of execution, requires wholly static type derivation, and documents the preexisting data object disambiguation.

challenge.method: Test possible runtime-only interpretation using the explicit compile-time sentence and check the invalid-position and preexisting-data-object cases from the same Release 754 page.
challenge.results: A valid inline declaration takes effect at compilation. Incompatible writing positions, insufficient static type derivation, and substring parsing from a data object named data limit applicability without contradicting the claim.

limitations: The documented form needs a compatible writing declaration position. An existing data object named data changes the interpretation of DATA(var) to substring access.
